# Hive:Magnus

> Full-stack agent management on your own infrastructure: Hive for suite installation and recovery; HiveXUI for the single browser console; Oathweave for identity; Emberpath for model routing; HiveMem for memory; HiveSkills for skills distribution; Magnus for Linux fleet operations; Ardent for durable agent tasks; Cindertrace for security investigations, cases, and evidence; ChatterMost for conversation; Emberfold for context continuity.

These projects can be used independently. Integrations are optional and require configuration. In a Hive installation, HiveXUI is the browser UI for every installed product, with sections only for those products. Ardent has its own repository, can be managed by Magnus, and bundles the Emberfold library; a separate Emberfold HTTP service is not required. Inference services and model storage remain external to Hive. This website publishes documentation and sample UI captures, not a hosted agent service or installation endpoint. The products use Apache-2.0. Hive installs only from a signed release, from a checkout of the release tag; the current suite release is 2.0.5 (https://github.com/ChefTaco/hive/releases/tag/v2.0.5).

Guides include prerequisites, documented commands, expected results, and the public source revision reviewed. Follow the linked current repository documentation for upgrades and configuration changes. Before editing a repository, read its AGENTS.md.

## Start here

- [Site overview](https://hivemagnus.com/index.md): Project selection, optional connections, and documentation links in Markdown.
- [Hive guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hive.md): Install suite release 2.0.5 with hive.sh from its tag, initial sign-in, Magnus host agents and Cindertrace collectors, the mandatory Hive Registry, external inference, and existing installations.
- [HiveXUI guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hivexui.md): The single browser console, what each section covers, and building it.
- [Magnus and Ardent guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/magnus.md): Run the fleet manager through Hive or on its own, the optional web terminal gateway, or Ardent independently with bundled Emberfold.
- [Cindertrace guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/cindertrace.md): Security investigations in HiveXUI or standalone, optional sources and integrations, the dedicated upgrade runbook, and the isolated three-stage investigation lab, which keeps its own console.
- [ChatterMost guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/chattermost.md): Verify and install the versioned Compose distribution, release 0.4.1, and connect an agent.
- [Emberfold guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/emberfold.md): Run a synthetic CLI dry run or use the TypeScript library; optional HTTP and Hermes interfaces.
- [Emberpath guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/emberpath.md): OpenAI-compatible model gateway with external providers, routing, quotas and traces.
- [Oathweave guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/oathweave.md): Identity, authentication, authorization, browser sign-in and service identities.
- [HiveMem guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hivemem.md): Memory storage, retrieval, sessions, graph evidence, consolidation and workspaces.
- [HiveSkills guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hiveskills.md): Skills registry, immutable archives, channels, assignments and distribution. Not the Hive Registry.
